longsword.name: Longsword
longsword.description: A classic one-handed sword with a long, straight blade. Can be wielded with two hands for increased damage.

healing-potion.name: Potion of Healing
healing-potion.description: A crimson liquid that glimmers when agitated. Drinking it restores vitality and heals wounds.

studded-leather.name: Studded Leather Armor
studded-leather.description: Made from tough but flexible leather, studded leather is reinforced with close-set rivets or spikes.

thieves-tools.name: Thieves' Tools
thieves-tools.description: A set of small tools including lock picks, small mirrors, small files, and narrow-bladed scissors.

rope-silk.name: Silk Rope (50 feet)
rope-silk.description: Strong, lightweight rope made from silk fibers. More durable than hemp rope but costs more.

spell-scroll-fireball.name: Spell Scroll (Fireball)
spell-scroll-fireball.description: A scroll containing the fireball spell. When read, it casts the spell and then crumbles to ash.
